exposure: Ultrasound-guided vacuum aspiration after local injection of lauromacrogol
Ultrasound-guided vacuum aspiration after uterine artery embolization (UAE)
transabdominal resection or hysteroscopy combined with laparoscopic resection
cohort: 160 women with type 2 cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
finding: The study found that ultrasound-guided vacuum aspiration after local injection of lauromacrogol was associated with lower cost and shorter hospitalization duration compared to UAE and surgery, and is recommended for type 2 CSP at <49 days of gestation.
gest_age: Type 2 CSP, with analysis of treatment failure suggesting significance difference based on gestational age; diagnostic thresholds at 49, 56, and 63 days of pregnancy were explored
